title: Optimal Gaussian approximation for complex Wiener-Itô integrals
summary: We study density regularity and optimal Gaussian approximation for complex multiple Wiener-Itô integrals. We first give a kernel criterion for absolute continuity and derive explicit formulas for the density and its derivatives, together with finite-order Sobolev estimates. Our main quantitative result shows that the sum of an intrinsic non-Gaussian term and the covariance mismatch gives the optimal rate simultaneously in every fixed Sobolev norm and in total variation, Kolmogorov and $1$-Wasserstein distances.
